1.3 二：极性 — 插画说明

工具：内置 image_gen（未使用 CLI/API 备用路径）。
日期：2026-11-02。
插画用于帮助理解具体关系；网页中的概念解释和来源注释保留其原有身份。

具足与表达.png
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a quiet educational editorial illustration for a Chinese philosophy reading website, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. A restrained East Asian ink wash and mineral-pigment drawing on a FLAT light warm grey paper background precisely #efeee8; charcoal #232925, muted moss #59664f, subtle aged gold #c6aa7c only. Large generous negative space. Fine organic ink linework, soft wash, visually clear meaningful shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no calligraphy, no seals, no borders, no logos, no mystical cosmos, no bright colors, no photorealism. The scene itself must explain a relationship, rather than act as decoration. Subject: a guqin on a simple wood table seen at a gentle overhead angle, drawn across the lower middle, its seven strings clear. On the LEFT a faint unplayed musical conception appears as a restrained cloudy contour hovering above the strings; on the RIGHT a single graceful hand plucks one string and three soft ink arcs/ripples flow out into ample open space. The same instrument connects both halves. Emphasize the difference between already having musical capability and a particular act of playing it. It must look peaceful and human, not supernatural. Keep upper third nearly empty; table only minimal outline, no other furniture.

视角与整体.png
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a quiet educational editorial illustration for a Chinese philosophy reading website, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. A restrained East Asian ink wash and mineral-pigment drawing on a FLAT light warm grey paper background precisely #efeee8; charcoal #232925, muted moss #59664f, subtle aged gold #c6aa7c only. Large generous negative space. Fine organic ink linework, soft wash, visually clear meaningful shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no calligraphy, no seals, no borders, no logos, no mystical cosmos, no bright colors, no photorealism. The scene itself must explain a relationship, rather than act as decoration. Subject: a low minimalist panorama of two tiny distinct observers, one on the left shore and one on the right shore of a quiet lake. Both look toward the same single small mountain ridge near center background. Each observer has a distinct actual location; each viewpoint belongs inside the same coherent landscape. A continuous pale mist and lake surface quietly links them. Two people should be very small, simple black ink silhouettes, no clothing detail; the SAME single landscape encompasses people, shores, mountain and reflection. Composition with observers around x=22% and x=78%, mountain at x=50%, large clear open lake in middle. No arrows, no circles, no labels, no diagrams. The whole is the landscape, and different perspectives remain inside it.

猫的整体与分支.png
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a quiet educational editorial illustration for a Chinese philosophy reading website, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. A restrained East Asian ink wash and mineral-pigment drawing on a FLAT light warm grey paper background precisely #efeee8; charcoal #232925, muted moss #59664f, subtle aged gold #c6aa7c only. Large generous negative space. Fine organic ink linework, soft wash, visually clear meaningful shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no calligraphy, no seals, no borders, no logos, no mystical cosmos, no bright colors, no photorealism. The scene itself must explain a relationship, rather than act as decoration. Subject: an understated conceptual illustration of Schroedinger's cat thought experiment. LEFT third: a clean closed wooden experimental box with a lid, a small simple detector and trigger apparatus connected by a thin cable; no labels. RIGHT two thirds: TWO separate pale soft-edge conceptual vignette spaces, upper one contains a small alert sitting black cat silhouette, lower one contains the SAME cat lying completely still on its side, peaceful and non-graphic, tail visible. The vignettes are alternative branches of one conceptual description, no suggestion of a third cat. Fine branching lines from the closed apparatus point toward the two vignettes. Simple legible forms, no horror, no gore, no poison bottle, no skulls. The cat branches are both clearly recognizable. Background the same uninterrupted #efeee8 paper.

笔墨与留白.png
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a quiet educational editorial illustration for a Chinese philosophy reading website, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. A restrained East Asian ink wash and mineral-pigment drawing on a FLAT light warm grey paper background precisely #efeee8; charcoal #232925, muted moss #59664f, subtle aged gold #c6aa7c only. Large generous negative space. Fine organic ink linework, soft wash, visually clear meaningful shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no calligraphy, no seals, no borders, no logos, no mystical cosmos, no bright colors, no photorealism. The scene itself must explain a relationship, rather than act as decoration. Subject: an elegant very sparse traditional shanshui ink landscape where unpainted paper CLEARLY becomes a winding river between two mountain shores. Left shore dark and near, right shore lighter and slightly farther away, two small dark pines on the left, a few fine horizontal shore lines. A very large graceful S-shaped empty-paper river through the center and foreground occupies half the composition. Distant mountain wash at top, open mist near upper center. The white/empty region is not a white painted shape; it is the untouched #efeee8 paper that gives the dark mountain shores their distance and shape. No boat, no people, no sun, no ornament. Crop coherent whole, strong ink vs unpainted space relationship.
